# Letterboxd

> > A social platform for movie tracking, film reviews, and discovering cinema through community-driven lists and diaries.

Letterboxd is a social network for film enthusiasts to log, rate, and review movies while connecting with other cinephiles. The platform offers mobile apps for iPhone, iPad, Android, and Apple TV, enabling users to maintain film diaries, create watchlists, and explore curated content across all genres from psychological thrillers to supernatural horror.

## Key Topics

- Film reviews and ratings
- Movie tracking and film diary
- Social platform for cinephiles
- Mobile apps (iOS and Android)
- Watchlists and collections
- Film discovery and recommendations
- User-generated content
- Genre exploration (thriller, horror, drama)
- Director and cast information
- Community-driven lists
- App Store and Play Store availability
- Apple TV integration
- Film database
- Movie social networking

## Mobile Apps & Platforms

- [Letterboxd Apps](https://letterboxd.com/apps/): Download Letterboxd apps for iPhone, iPad, Android, and Apple TV platforms
